## Detailed findings

### C-01

**Sensitive state change without access control**

**Severity:** Critical · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `missing-access-control` · **SWC:** [SWC-105](https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-105) · **CWE:** [CWE-284](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/284.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/LegacyToken.sol` line 13 — `LegacyToken.LegacyTokn`

```solidity
owner = msg.sender;
```

**Description**

Anyone can call `LegacyTokn()` and modify privileged variable `owner`.

**Recommendation**

Restrict the function with `onlyOwner`/`onlyRole` or an explicit `msg.sender` check.

<sub>Fingerprint: `68255e77a2b19524`</sub>

### C-02

**Delegatecall to user-controlled address**

**Severity:** Critical · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `controlled-delegatecall` · **SWC:** [SWC-112](https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-112) · **CWE:** [CWE-829](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/UpgradeableWallet.sol` line 34 — `UpgradeableWallet.execute`

```solidity
(bool ok, bytes memory ret) = target.delegatecall(data);
```

**Description**

Anyone can make `UpgradeableWallet` delegatecall into an arbitrary address `target` through `execute(address,bytes)`.

**Recommendation**

Only delegatecall to trusted, immutable implementation addresses, and restrict any function that changes the implementation with access control.

**References:** <https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-112>

<sub>Fingerprint: `462f7d62004f80f7`</sub>

### C-03

**Unprotected selfdestruct**

**Severity:** Critical · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `unprotected-selfdestruct` · **SWC:** [SWC-106](https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-106) · **CWE:** [CWE-284](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/284.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/UpgradeableWallet.sol` line 47 — `UpgradeableWallet.kill`

```solidity
selfdestruct(to);
```

**Description**

`kill(address payable)` can be called by anyone and destroys the contract.

**Recommendation**

Remove `selfdestruct` (deprecated by EIP-6049) or restrict it to a trusted role.

**References:** <https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-106>

<sub>Fingerprint: `c40206843f6dd4f5`</sub>

### C-04

**Unprotected proxy upgrade**

**Severity:** Critical · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `unprotected-upgrade` · **CWE:** [CWE-284](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/284.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/UpgradeableWallet.sol` line 51 — `UpgradeableWallet._authorizeUpgrade`

```solidity
function _authorizeUpgrade(address) internal override {}
```

**Description**

`_authorizeUpgrade` does not restrict who may upgrade the implementation.

**Recommendation**

**References:** <https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts/5.x/api/proxy#UUPSUpgradeable-_authorizeUpgrade-address->

### H-04

**Weak source of randomness**

**Severity:** High · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `weak-prng` · **SWC:** [SWC-120](https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-120) · **CWE:** [CWE-338](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/338.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/Lottery.sol` line 23 — `Lottery.pickWinner`

```solidity
uint256 index = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.prevrandao, players.length))) % players.length;
```

**Description**

`uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.prevrandao, players.length))) %…` derives a pseudo-random value from `block.prevrandao`, `block.timestamp`.

**Recommendation**

Use a verifiable randomness source such as Chainlink VRF, or a commit-reveal scheme.

**References:** <https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-120>

<sub>Fingerprint: `0c6414034d807e2f`</sub>

### H-05

**Reentrancy with ETH transfer**

**Severity:** High · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `reentrancy-eth` · **SWC:** [SWC-107](https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-107) · **CWE:** [CWE-841](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/841.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/ReentrancyVault.sol` line 20 — `ReentrancyVault.withdraw`

```solidity
(bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");
```

**Description**

`withdraw(uint256)` in `ReentrancyVault` makes an external call `msg.sender.call{value: amount}("")` and only then updates `balances` (line 22), `totalDeposits` (line 23). A malicious callee can re-enter while this state is stale.

**Recommendation**

Apply the Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern: update all state *before* making the external call, and/or protect the function with a reentrancy guard such as OpenZeppelin's `nonReentrant`.

**References:** <https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-107>, <https://docs.soliditylang.org/en/latest/security-considerations.html#reentrancy>

<sub>Fingerprint: `60899982f606d506`</sub>

### H-06

**Reentrancy with ETH transfer**

**Severity:** High · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `reentrancy-eth` · **SWC:** [SWC-107](https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-107) · **CWE:** [CWE-841](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/841.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/ReentrancyVault.sol` line 29 — `ReentrancyVault.withdrawAll`

```solidity
_send(msg.sender, amount);
```

**Description**

`withdrawAll()` in `ReentrancyVault` makes an external call `payable(to).call{value: amount}("")` (via internal call to `_send()`) and only then updates `balances` (line 39 in `_clear()`). A malicious callee can re-enter while this state is stale.

**Recommendation**

Apply the Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern: update all state *before* making the external call, and/or protect the function with a reentrancy guard such as OpenZeppelin's `nonReentrant`.

**References:** <https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-107>, <https://docs.soliditylang.org/en/latest/security-considerations.html#reentrancy>

<sub>Fingerprint: `7fb21b16452eb7f1`</sub>

### H-07

**Unprotected initializer**

**Severity:** High · **Confidence:** high · **Detector:** `unprotected-initializer` · **CWE:** [CWE-665](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/665.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/UpgradeableWallet.sol` line 18 — `UpgradeableWallet.initialize`

```solidity
function initialize(address _owner) external {
```

**Description**

`initialize(address)` initializes state (feeBps, owner) and can be called by anyone, any number of times.

**Recommendation**

Use OpenZeppelin's `Initializable` and mark the function `initializer`; call `_disableInitializers()` in the implementation's constructor.

**References:** <https://docs.openzeppelin.com/upgrades-plugins/writing-upgradeable#initializers>

<sub>Fingerprint: `db1ce15b2fdff1ae`</sub>

### H-12

**Signature replay**

**Severity:** High · **Confidence:** medium · **Detector:** `signature-replay` · **SWC:** [SWC-121](https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-121) · **CWE:** [CWE-294](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/294.html)

**Location:** `examples/contracts/SignatureWallet.sol` line 15 — `SignatureWallet.withdraw`

```solidity
address recovered = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
```

**Description**

`withdraw(address payable,uint256,uint8,bytes32,bytes32)` verifies a signature but tracks no nonce or used-signature state; it can be replayed.

**Recommendation**

Sign EIP-712 typed data including a per-signer nonce, `block.chainid` and `address(this)`; mark nonces as used.

**References:** <https://swcregistry.io/docs/SWC-121>, <https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-712>
